feedback: Checkout was confusing because shipping costs appeared too late. I almost abandoned the cart.
The discount code did not work and the error message was unclear.
Pricing looks fair, but I need to compare bundles before choosing the higher plan.
I could not tell whether the gift message would be included before payment.
My account points are missing from the dashboard and support cannot explain the status.
The checkout page is slow on mobile and sometimes loses my address.
Bulk reorder would save time because I buy the same items every month.
I am worried I selected the wrong shipping option because there is no final preview.
The delivery date was unclear and I needed confidence before placing the order.
The rewards page is useful, but I need better visibility into when points expire.
